scope: Source-relative external form, visible details, stated unknown surfaces and declared manufacturing substitutions. This is not numerical mesh, global thickness, support, slicer, printability or release approval.

identity.project: 原興國管理學院女生宿舍暨演講廳

era: Early completed exterior of architect project completed 2001; photograph capture dates unknown; not a complete contemporary survey.
delivery_path_mapping: Reviewed metadata-cleaned preview bytes are to be copied unchanged into previews/v11; hashes govern this binding.

geometry_estimates.status: Proportional modeling estimates only. Early 68 m high-wing cue was rejected for a mixed-height endpoint. No +/-2m accuracy guarantee. Plan drawing units and exact levels are unconfirmed.

critical_corrections_retained: High bars parallel, not an equal-height perpendicular L.
South rear step ratio about0.766, checked independently in plan and same-roof image points.
North/low eastern end extends east of the south high end.
Open northwest court and curved steps retained.
Photographed south twelve-bay 1+8+3 rhythm, eight top slots and six detached front arches.
unknowns: Main long-wing north elevation direction is feature-registration inference; simplified design detail, not completed-project photographic verification.
North short-wing north openings are unverified. Blank simplified shell must not be described as a verified real blank wall.
Absolute dimensions, levels, fine projections, roof equipment and inaccessible interiors are not measured or fully reconstructed.
manufacturing_substitutions: Approx 0.91 mm window outer frames and thickened thin roots.
Approx 0.5 mm planar expansion/rounding of foreground arcade and rounding of selected supports, internal arch uprights and curved-step ends.
Window headers rooted at true opening tops and curved-step ends slightly overlapped into the wall.
Upper pale arch rim thickened; unverified eastern roof inset omitted while preserving major silhouette.
phase_exclusions: No invented roof equipment, neighboring building or source-image textures.
documentation_review: README, core geometry plan and estimate/simplification text disclose early phase, unresolved north short rear, corrected estimates and manufacturing changes.

front.finding: Southeast overview retains the two near-parallel high bars, recessed south eastern return, lower hall, extended north/east end, separated arcade and broad low entry.
front.evidence: Architect completed-project southeast photographs plus plan and orthophoto relative shape.

rear.finding: Main long-wing courtyard openings use the inferred reverse design elevation. North short-wing rear remains a conspicuous unverified blank simplification, not mirrored photo detail.
rear.evidence: Architect reverse design elevation by feature registration; no complete north-short-wing rear photograph.

west.finding: South west-end projecting glazing and stacked plates remain distinct from the eastern entrance. Unseen short-wing surfaces remain reduced.
west.evidence: Architect southwest corner photograph and design end projection.

east.finding: South return and separate lower hall remain legible; north short-wing east-end dark recesses, stacked plates and partial parapets follow the visible photograph at reduced detail.
east.evidence: Architect southeast and distant photographs, with conservative partial-view simplification.

south.finding: Twelve main bays, lower west 1 / central 8 / east 3 grouping, eight roof-band slots, shallow upper arch and broad pale lower band, horizontal east windows and six foreground arches remain identifiable.
south.evidence: Multiple architect completed-project south-façade photographs; photos take precedence over design changes.

north.finding: Long-wing north grouping is design-derived and not photo-verified. Short-wing north openings are deliberately not invented; the blank surface is an unknown placeholder.
north.evidence: Inferred reverse design elevation only for the main long wing; short-wing north remains unknown.

top.finding: Parallel high bars, south rear step near 0.766 of main length, extended northern/eastern end, distinct lower hall and open northwest court are maintained. No later photovoltaics or invented roof equipment.
top.evidence: Plan relative axes and same-roof orthophoto ratios; all absolute dimensions are estimates.

entry-detail.finding: Large high arch retains its shallow dark opening over a broad pale solid band; entry canopy, stairs, doorway and supports remain readable after declared thickening/rounding.
entry-detail.evidence: Architect southeast entrance photograph and plan; small-scale manufacture substitutions disclosed.

roof-detail.finding: West projection, south bay rhythm, detached six-arch wall and main roof/step silhouette survive manufacturing changes. Unverified east roof recess is omitted without changing the major outline.
roof-detail.evidence: Architect southwest/south photographs and plan; flat roofs are conservative early-envelope simplification.

privacy: This report contains no source imagery or private analytical plates; source photographs, drawings, orthophotos and derivative crops are not included.
